target_customer: Trucking carriers and freight forwarders in Germany that run dispatch and back office on a TMS
problem: Carrier back offices spend headcount on repetitive order entry, document handling, quoting, invoice checks and exception emails.
business_model: B2B software subscription for AI agents sold to carriers, pricing not stated
product_category: AI agents for logistics back office

founders.name: Felix Lösch
prior_employers: Series A robotics logistics startup in Germany (Managing Director)

founders.name: Niclas Heun
education: Technical University of Munich, computer science
founders.background_notes: Former AI researcher on model robustness.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents that read documents and write to varied TMS systems are feasible with current models, but integration breadth and reliability are hard.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations into a carrier's TMS and rules add some lock-in, but the underlying models are available to all.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A trade press piece dated May 2026 says TMS vendors are adding AI to trucking back office tasks, after the batch.

market_need_then: Back office staffing cost in logistics and the arrival of capable LLM agents in 2025. The company claims paying customers in Germany, per a job post, unverified.

identity.logo: Orange hero and cream icon versions referenced on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident fragments in logistics vocabulary, such as More loads. Same team.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage, a distinctive invented name, no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Lunavo is a Fall 2025 company with two founders and no public funding or exit yet. Its founders combine logistics operating experience with applied AI, which suggests founder market fit, but there is too little evidence for a firm outcome view. The main risks are TMS vendors adding the same features and the breadth of integrations.
notes: No funding source found; one aggregator reports 500K pre-seed, unverified and not recorded as a round. Directories conflict on product focus (carriers vs forwarders) and location (Munich area vs Bavaria). Competitor search surfaced only 2025 to 2026 vendor releases that are mostly forwarder tools or undated, so the list is empty. Outcome search found only the YC launch post (2025-11-05). Update: the 500K pre-seed announced 2025-12 is recorded from VCBacked only (single database, no press or filing found in a second search; its last funding round field is blank).
